copy.tagline: 用 ASO 和变现策略快速推广移动应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在开发移动应用并希望提升下载量和收入。
copy.tagline_en: Boost mobile app growth with ASO, viral loops, and monetization tactics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing a mobile app and want to increase downloads and revenue.

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 能帮你分析并优化移动应用的推广和变现策略，包括 App Store 关键词、截图设计、评分管理、病毒增长、订阅定价、付费广告、留存和发布计划等。
howto.when: 当你询问关于移动应用的增长、ASO、变现、留存或发布策略时，Claude 会接管并给出专业建议。

say.text: 帮我优化这个iOS应用的ASO关键词。
say.note: Claude会根据App Store规则提供关键词建议。

say.text: 分析我的应用留存率并给出改进方案。
say.note: Claude会基于留存曲线和推送策略提供建议。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can analyze and optimize mobile app growth strategies, including ASO, screenshots design, ratings management, viral loops, monetization, paid acquisition, retention, and launch tactics.
howto.when_en: When you ask about mobile app growth, ASO, monetization, retention, or launch strategy, Claude will step in with expert advice.

say_en.text: Help me optimize ASO keywords for this iOS app.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest keywords based on App Store guidelines.

say_en.text: Analyze my app retention rate and suggest improvements.
say_en.note: Claude will propose retention strategies based on cohort analysis.
